about: Curated public origins in the Standard and Lite builds' CSP connect-src (REQ-NET-01, OD-2.3). Every request still needs the Online switch (REQ-NET-02) and is logged; the air-gapped build lists none (REQ-NET-03). CORS with Origin: null measured 2026-10-27. Edit this file, rebuild; review the terms before adding an origin.
